name: Meal And Grocery Planner
description: 3 agents working together to find potential recipes that meet specified criteria (eg: dietary restrictions or ingredient contents), plans which ones to use for a menu over the next 14 days, then assembles a shopping list for these

inputParameters.name: shopping_list_agent
inputParameters.prompt:
Create a new shopping list with the following items:

- 1 lb of bacon
- 500ml of milk (convert to Imperial units such as cups/quarts/gallons first)
- 1 small wheel of extra sharp cheddar cheese
- spam
- 6 eggs
- more spam
- 3 16oz cans of Garbanzo beans

Then show me the final list.

agentConfig.name: shopping_list_agent
agentConfig.instructions:
You help manage a shopping list. Use add_item to add items, 
    get_list to view the list, and clear_list to reset it. 
    
    IMPORTANT: Always add all items first, then call get_list separately
    in a follow-up step to verify the list contents. Never call get_list
    in the same batch as add_item calls.
    
    After verifying the list, summarize the items for the user and stop.

tools.name: add_item
tools.description:
Add an item to the shared shopping list.

Args:
    item: The item to add.
    context: Injected tool context with shared state.

Returns:
    Dictionary confirming the addition.

tools.name: get_list
tools.description:
Get the current shopping list from shared state.

Args:
    context: Injected tool context with shared state.

Returns:
    Dictionary with the current list.

tools.name: clear_list
tools.description:
Clear the shopping list.

Args:
    context: Injected tool context with shared state.

Returns:
    Dictionary confirming the clear.
